body_markdown:
Audio is woven into everyday life across routines, devices, content and platforms. As listening behaviors continue to evolve, so do the opportunities for marketers to connect with consumers.


The **2026 State of Audio** report, from Comscore in partnership with TuneIn, explores how people are listening today, what they expect from audio experiences, and what it means for advertisers.


[Download the Report](https://www.comscore.com/Request/Presentations/2026/2026-State-of-Audio)


**Inside the report**


- How audio fits into consumers’ daily lives
- How listening behaviors are evolving across formats
- What consumers expect from ad-supported audio
- What the findings mean for advertisers


**Want to go deeper?**


Join Comscore and TuneIn on **October 22** for a live webinar where we’ll unpack the findings and discuss what they mean for the future of audio advertising.


[Register for the Webinar](https://www.comscore.com/Insights/Events-and-Webinars/Webinar/2026/2026-State-of-Audio-Webinar)
